summary: Kennametal Inc. filed an 8-K on May 28, 2026, reporting amendments to its credit agreements, including a First Amendment to its Seventh Amended and Restated Credit Agreement and a new $500 million Term Loan Credit Agreement. These are routine debt financing arrangements, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other transformative event is involved. The filing updates existing credit facilities and is classified as a material definitive agreement, but it does not trigger a special-situations category. The registrant is the issuer/borrower.
